description: Strength of Mount Mugamba Level 60 Master <name>, you return! Molthor has sent word of your deeds to the King. Your name is known even in the South Seas. Perhaps one day you will be a legendary <class> - a story for the ages. Give me your talisman so that I may once more amplify its power. Requirements: - Strength of Mugamba
name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
